column1: You write down the vehicle information: 1988 green "CMG" sedan. License #C43256.
column2: 你記下車輛資訊：1988 年綠色「CMG」房車。車牌號碼 #C43256。

column1: Get closer to the rental agents so that they can see the mug shot.
column2: 靠近租車員，讓他們看得見嫌犯照片。

column1: Looking around, you see a car rental agency and not much else.
column2: 你環顧四周，只看見一家租車公司，沒有其他東西。

column1: The car rental agency's name is "Top Hat."
column2: 租車公司的名稱是「高帽」。

column1: CPA stands for "Cheap Prices Available."
column2: CPA 代表「提供便宜價格」。

column1: The fine print says: "Our rental cars are for the birds...they're CHEEP!"
column2: 細字寫著：「我們的租車是給鳥兒的……因為它們很便宜！」

column1: Nice ceiling.
column2: 天花板不錯。

column1: Nice floor.
column2: 地板不錯。

column1: There are two turtle-looking agents behind the rental agency counter.
column2: 租車櫃檯後有兩名看起來像烏龜的職員。

column1: Top hats, of course!
column2: 當然是高帽！

column1: There aren't any real turtles in here.
column2: 這裡沒有真正的烏龜。

column1: Turn around.
column2: 轉身。

column1: Through the window you see the airport tarmac.
column2: 透過窗戶，你看見機場停機坪。

column1: Just a chair.
column2: 只是一張椅子。

column1: Another pointlessly pointillistic painting.
column2: 另一幅毫無意義的點描畫。

column1: Dressed in a silly-looking green tux, the Top Hat car rental agent looks back with a blank stare.
column2: 高帽租車員穿著滑稽的綠色燕尾服，面無表情地回望。

column1: That isn't necessary.
column2: 那不需要。

column1: Without justification, Bonds, That would be kidnapping!
column2: 沒有正當理由，邦茲，那會構成綁架！

column1: You have absolutely no reason to cuff the person.
column2: 你完全沒有理由銬住這個人。

column1: Your own car is outside.
column2: 你自己的車在外面。

column1: You won't need a top hat where you're going.
column2: 你要去的地方不需要高帽。

column1: Can I help you? asks the agent.
column2: 「我能幫你嗎？」租車員問道。

column1: The agent looks at you and says..."Dependable transportation is our business."
column2: 租車員看著你說……「可靠的交通工具是我們的事業。」

column1: Rest assured, you're in good hands with Top Hat, cracks the agent.
column2: 租車員開玩笑說：「放心，交給高帽就對了。」

column1: At Top Hat, our cars may be sssslllooooowww, but they're TOPS!
column2: 「在高帽，我們的車也許慢——吞——吞，但都是頂級貨！」
